answer: A whisper campaign of fake accounts costs the attacker a full bond per identity plus slashing if collusion is detected, while honest agents recover their plume of reputation over epochs. Sybil resistance here relies on stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond at a unique vertex in the reputation graph, and peers only count votes from identities whose bond exceeds the median. Cheap identities cannot survive because every new vertex requires real capital at risk, making mass fabrication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
